import json
from pathlib import Path

base = Path("bench/results/environment-narration/t9h/full")
assert json.loads((base / "spent.json").read_text())["spent_micro_usd"] <= 450000

def route_rows(name, expected_replicates, expected_turns, last_input):
    route_base = base / name / "rows"
    assert (route_base / "rows.json").is_file(), f"missing {route_base / 'rows.json'}"
    assert (route_base / "summary.json").is_file(), f"missing {route_base / 'summary.json'}"
    rows = json.loads((route_base / "rows.json").read_text())
    summary = json.loads((route_base / "summary.json").read_text())
    assert summary["enforce"] is True
    assert summary.get("shadow", False) is False
    for row in rows:
        for turn in row.get("turns", []):
            for field in ("turn_elapsed_s", "enforce_attempts", "narration_attempts", "observation_request", "engine_opened", "focus_open_state_after", "focus_open_state_committed", "handoff_id", "delivered_text", "call_timings"):
                assert field in turn
    if summary.get("stopped_reason") is None:
        assert len(rows) == expected_replicates
        assert all(len(row.get("turns", [])) == expected_turns for row in rows)
        assert all(row["turns"][-1]["input"] == last_input for row in rows)

route_rows("c", 5, 6, "look under the drawer")
c_summary = json.loads((base / "c" / "rows" / "summary.json").read_text())
if c_summary.get("stopped_reason") is None:
    route_rows("d", 10, 6, "look under the workstation chair")
    d_summary = json.loads((base / "d" / "rows" / "summary.json").read_text())
    if d_summary.get("stopped_reason") is None:
        route_rows("e", 10, 6, "inspect the storm drain")
        e_summary = json.loads((base / "e" / "rows" / "summary.json").read_text())
        if e_summary.get("stopped_reason") is None:
            route_rows("f", 10, 6, "look under the executive desk")
print("checked t9h routes and spent cap")
PY
